verdict.rationale: Capacities exposes a documented REST API (Bearer-auth, OpenAPI spec verified live) that lets developers create and manipulate content programmatically, which satisfies the 'local endpoint' part of the story for scripting/automation. However, there is no evidence of a URI scheme or deep-link mechanism for opening/creating notes from other apps, only a hosted (not local) API and MCP server. Missing for 10: documented URI scheme or deep-link support, evidence of a local (non-cloud) endpoint, and independent confirmation of scripting workflows beyond the API docs.
